title: Agent Agenda: Key Advances in AI Autonomy, Efficiency, and Intelligence
angle: A concise overview of the latest breakthroughs in AI agents, including self-feedback for LLMs (PivoARL), multimodal foundation models (iFLYTEK-Embodied-Omni), and multi-agent coordination (SwarmResearch), highlighting how these developments push AI towards greater autonomy and sophisticated problem-solving.
rationale: Several stories today revolve around agentic AI, making a roundup the perfect format to connect these related but distinct advancements for readers interested in the cutting edge of AI autonomy.
